terra.problem: It says someone cannot be restored from across the street. Paul does not specify a distance or method for restoring someone.
It says the helper may be tempted by the very thing he is helping with. Paul warns that the helper may be tempted, but does not say it will be the same temptation.
It says the helper could face the same temptation. Paul does not specify that the temptation would be the same.
The statement that Moses brought the law from God is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The comparison about talking himself into a sale and then buying it is hard to picture and does not make the joke clear.
The line about not borrowing someone else's work changes Paul's point. He contrasts boasting in oneself with boasting in someone else, not borrowing another person's work.
